subject: Implementation matrix and rollout cadence for MedLumen private deployment
messages:
From: Evan Keller <evan.keller@medlumen.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planning call follow-up — implementation info request

Thanks Soojin — really helpful call this morning. Our security and networking teams asked for a concise implementation matrix we can use to coordinate windows and approvals. Specifically we need:
- VPC peering preferred maintenance windows (PST) and expected cutover duration
- Private endpoint IP ranges and any required customer CIDR reservations
- On-prem appliance staging schedule and image/firmware details (we have a staging rack on Oct 18–20)

If you can send a draft matrix and a short rollout cadence (who does what, rough durations), we can route it for approval on our side and confirm dates.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Keller
Head of Cloud Ops, MedLumen
Evan.Keller@medlumen.com

Attachment: medlumen-current-inventory.xlsx (reference, attached by client)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Evan Keller <evan.keller@medlumen.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation matrix + proposed cadence (v1)

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear asks. Draft attached and summarized below. I kept the matrix aligned to our standard private deployment checklist so your security team has traceability.

Summary (high level):
- Phase 0: Preflight (2–3 business days) — inventory, IP allocations, SOC/SSO questionnaire review. Owner: MedLumen + Redwood SRE.
- Phase 1: Network prep & VPC peering (1 business day maintenance window) — create peering, route tables, security groups, test connectivity. Owner: MedLumen network + Redwood infra. Expected outage: none (warm cutover).
- Phase 2: Private endpoints & DNS (same day as Phase 1 or following day) — provision private endpoints, validate TLS certs, DNS split-horizon. Owner: Redwood + MedLumen DNS.
- Phase 3: Appliance staging & image validation (2 days) — SHA checks, firmware, image manifest verification, local acceptance tests. Owner: Redwood field team + MedLumen ops.
- Phase 4: Cutover & smoke (half-day window) — ramp traffic, monitor KPIs, rollback plan ready. Owner: joint.

Attachments included: implementation-matrix-v1.xlsx (matrix with owners/dates/checkpoints), private-endpoints-checklist.xlsx (IPs, DNS entries).

Next steps: please review the matrix and indicate preferred maintenance windows. Marissa will own appliance staging logistics; Laura will own the network validation runbook. If those owners are OK, we can lock a tentative cutover week.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: implementation-matrix-v1.xlsx (Excel)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Evan Keller <evan.keller@medlumen.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation matrix + proposed cadence (appliance & staging notes)

Adding appliance/staging details from the field ops side — thanks for looping me in. Key notes: 
- Staging rack availability: Oct 18–20 (as Evan mentioned). We'll ship the appliance image ahead of time and confirm SHA256.
- Image/firmware: Redwood appliance image v2.1.3 (signed). I will attach the manifest and the preliminary runbook.
- Rack requirements: 1U, inbound/outbound firewall rules list in the runbook, and an ops VPN endpoint for console access.
- Logistics: if MedLumen can confirm onsite contact and rack access times by Oct 5, we can prioritize a staging dry-run the week of Oct 11.

Attachment: appliance-image-manifest.txt (image checksum and tooling notes)

Laura — can you confirm the network test plan (iperf, TLS handshake validation, KV cache validation surface) fits within the 1-day peering window?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Field Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Evan Keller <evan.keller@medlumen.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation matrix + proposed cadence for MedLumen private deployment

All looks good — appreciate the level of detail. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can reserve Oct 18–20 for appliance staging; onsite contact is Priya Rao (priya.rao@medlumen.com).
- Preferred peering window: Oct 21, 22:00–02:00 PST (we'll route change approvals through our change board on Oct 19).
- Private endpoint CIDR: we can allocate 10.47.128.0/26 (reserve for endpoints and NAT where needed).

I attached our ops window preferences (csv) for your scheduling team. If you can mark Oct 21 on the matrix as tentative for peering and Oct 22 as a fallback smoke day, we can start internal approval.

Thanks — Evan

Attachment: ops-window-preferences.csv (operational windows exported from our change calendar)
